newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in moderate trade on Wednesday, with most traders sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. August Beige Book report, dealers said.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning except for some light activity at the short end. Some traders are waiting for fresh clued to market direction from tonight's release of the Beige Book report," a local dealer said.
"But I don't think there will be much impact here unless the figures are way off market expectations," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Wednesday/Thursday and Thursday/Friday eased 1/16 percentage point each to a common 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent, respectively.
Week-fixed was unchanged from Tuesday's 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.
Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16, nine-months unchanged at 5-7/8 5-3/4 and twelve-months unchanged at 6 5-7/8 percent.
